devops-bot: Build 2026-03-20-rc3 for private-installer completed. Images pushed to gcr.redwood-inference/private/installer:2026-03-20-rc3. Airgap bundle: gs://redwood-releases/private/installer-2026-03-20-rc3.tar.gz. sha256: 7f3a9c... :package:
Maya (release-eng): Uploaded draft release notes and candidate manifest to Drive. Need cosign sigs and final checksums before canary. Any blockers?
Nikhil (packaging): Cosign signatures done for all images, pushed .sig to the bucket. Verify with: ```cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-keyring gcr.redwood-inference/private/installer:2026-03-20-rc3```
Eli (QA): Running smoke on QA cluster — failing initially on post-install DB migrations (timeout). Logs: `timeout waiting for migration lock`. Retrying now.
Eli (QA): Retry passed but saw 3 warnings from storage driver. Filing flake RH-2231. Recommend holding canary for 1h to run full upgrade matrix.
Sofia (sre): Can we pin runtime images to `runtime:v2.1.4-quant` in the manifest? Upgrade path touching older quant kernels caused perf blips in staging. Also update `manifest.yaml` to use digests, not tags.
Nikhil (packaging): Pinned manifest.yaml and regenerated bundle. Pushed new tarball; new tarball sha256: a9d8f2... Manifest now references digests.
Jason (oncall): Given QA flake, propose canary window 2026-03-21 03:00-04:00 UTC (low EU traffic). If error rate >5% sustained for 15m, rollback to `2026-03-10-stable`. :warning:
Maya (release-eng): Agree. I'll update the release calendar and send the notes draft to legal for export control review.
devops-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for private-installer:2026-03-20-rc3 at 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z. Rollback target: 2026-03-10-stable. Image pins locked for the window. :calendar:
Eli (QA): I'll run full upgrade matrix during the window and post smoke check summaries at +5m and +30m.
Sofia (sre): Found an airgap bootstrap issue — installer defaults to the external mirror which fails in true airgapped envs. Patch will add `--skip-download` flag and doc note. Pushing fix now.
Nikhil (packaging): Patch pushed to `release/2026-03-20-fix-airgap-mirror`. Regenerating bundle now. ETA ~18m.
Maya (release-eng): Hold release notes until final tarball checksum confirmed. If rollback is required during canary ping #oncall immediately.
devops-bot: Artifact updated: gs://redwood-releases/private/installer-2026-03-20-rc3-v2.tar.gz sha256: b1c2d4... cosign signatures refreshed. last_action: upload
